clips.title: The story
paras: The Bloodtalon Matriarch is the formidable leader of a swift and cunning raptor pack near Sen'jin Village. After proving too dangerous and stubborn to tame as an adult, she must be confronted so her offspring can be raised from the egg as loyal companions for the Darkspear tribe.

The Bloodtalon pack is renowned along the coast of Durotar for its remarkable speed and keen cunning. Handlers in Sen'jin Village prize these traits above all else when seeking dependable mounts and companions for the Darkspear tribe. However, full-grown raptors possess stubborn and violent instincts, making adults almost impossible to domesticate once they have adapted to life in the wild.

Despite multiple attempts to capture and train the Matriarch directly, her escalating aggression turned her into an outright threat to the surrounding territory. To safeguard the tribe while ensuring her exceptional bloodline was not lost, the trolls resolved to quell the dangerous mother and salvage her clutch, ensuring the next generation can be raised as loyal allies from the egg.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: All of the raptors you see before you are ones I have trained myself. They come from all over Kalimdor, but some of the finest come from the Bloodtalon raptors on the isles off our coast.

One raptor amongst them, the Bloodtalon Matriarch, is particularly savage and has killed many from our village and has become too dangerous to leave at our borders. If you can strike her down, return with her eggs so that we can raise the hatchlings as allies instead of enemies.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Bloodtalon are known for their cunning and swiftness, and make fine companions when raised from egg to adult.
Unfortunately adult raptors are very difficult to train, and I have tried to capture the Matriarch on more than one occasion. But she had become too dangerous of late.
Still I hope to preserve her legacy by raising her children as companions here in Sen'Jin.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. I am happy we will be able to preserve her bloodline and raise them to be our allies. You have done a great service for our tribe.
